series.name: RHI-(3-6)K-48ES-5G (single-phase hybrid + 48V battery)
series.notes: RHI is the 48 V single-phase hybrid line; the LCD prints TEXT names ONLY (no hex, no DATA field) - that is the difference from S5-EH1P-L / S6-EH1P-L which print 'NAME (10xx DATA:0000)'. The RHI table has its OWN battery-side rows (OV-Vbatt1, OV-Vbatt-H, Over-Load, OV-VBackup) that do not exist on the string-only on-grid tables. Do not merge with SERIES 4. Note the official EUR S5-EH1P(3-6)K-L(-BE) manual and the RHI manual share hardware and the same three-LED layout, but the LCD code format is still what differs, so they stay in separate blocks.

meaning.en: The RHI has not detected the 48 V pack, so it is running as a normal grid-tied PV inverter with no storage.
meaning.ur: RHI ne 48 V pack detect nahi kiya, is liye ye normal grid-tied PV inverter ki tarah bina storage ke chal raha hai.

causes.en: Battery power cable not connected, or the battery breaker/isolator is open
causes.ur: Battery power cable connected nahi, ya battery breaker ya isolator khula hai

causes.en: Battery output voltage outside the 42-58 V window the RHI expects
causes.ur: Battery output voltage RHI ke liye 42-58 V range se bahar hai

solutions.en: Check the wire of battery power is connected correctly or not: reseat both battery power lugs and tighten them.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke battery power wire sahi se connected hai ya nahi: dono battery power lugs dobara fit karke tighten karein.

solutions.en: Check the output voltage of the battery with a multimeter at the inverter end; the RHI expects roughly 42-58 V for a 48 V pack.
solutions.ur: Multimeter se inverter ke taraf battery ka output voltage measure karein; 48 V pack ke liye RHI ko taqreeban 42-58 V chahiye.

solutions.en: If the pack is not being installed yet, set the battery select to 'No Battery' so the alarm is suppressed and the unit works like a normal grid-tied inverter.
solutions.ur: Agar pack abhi lagaya nahi ja raha to battery select ko 'No Battery' par kar dein taake alarm na aaye aur unit normal grid-tied inverter ki tarah chale.

source.title: Solis RHI(3-6)K-5G / RHI-(3.6)K-48ES-5G Series Hybrid Inverter User Manual ENX V1,5, Table 8.1 Fault message and description

meaning.en: Battery 1 voltage is above the configured overvoltage protection point, so the RHI stopped charge and discharge.
meaning.ur: Battery 1 ka voltage set kiye gaye overvoltage protection point se upar hai, is liye RHI ne charge aur discharge rok diya.

causes.en: Battery pack charged above the inverter's overvoltage protection setting
causes.ur: Battery pack inverter ke overvoltage protection setting se upar charge ho gaya

causes.en: Two packs on the 48 V bus imbalanced, so one pack sits high while the other sits low
causes.ur: 48 V bus par do packs unbalanced hain, ek high par hai aur doosra low par

causes.en: Battery aged so its resting voltage is higher than a new pack of the same SoC
causes.ur: Battery purani ho gayi is liye wisi SoC par uska resting voltage naye pack se zyada hai

solutions.en: Check the protect point for overvoltage sets correctly or not: read the battery overvoltage protection value in Advanced Settings > 0010 and compare it with the battery maker's maximum charge voltage.
solutions.ur: Overvoltage ke liye protection point sahi set hai ya nahi check karein: Advanced Settings > 0010 mein battery overvoltage protection value padhein aur battery maker ki maximum charge voltage se compare karein.

solutions.en: Measure each pack separately with a multimeter; if one pack reads noticeably higher, re-balance or isolate the packs before restarting.
solutions.ur: Har pack ko alag alag multimeter se measure karein; koi ek pack zyada padhe to packs ko dobara balance karein ya alag karein phir restart karein.

solutions.en: Restart the inverter once and confirm the code clears; if it returns on a full battery, the protection point or the pack is at fault.
solutions.ur: Inverter ek baar restart karke confirm karein ke code hat gaya; full battery par wapas aaye to protection point ya pack kharab hai.

notes.en: RHI names the battery-side code OV-Vbatt1 (with the digit 1) because the RHI can carry two battery channels; the S5-EH1P-L / S6-EH1P-L manuals print the same condition without the digit.
notes.ur: RHI battery-side code ko OV-Vbatt1 (digit 1 ke saath) kehta hai kyunke RHI do battery channels carry kar sakta hai; S5-EH1P-L / S6-EH1P-L manual wahi halat digit ke baghair print karte hain.

source.title: Solis RHI(3-6)K-5G / RHI-(3.6)K-48ES-5G Series Hybrid Inverter User Manual ENX V1,5, Table 8.1 Fault message and description

title.ur: Battery circuit ka hardware overvoltage fault (OV-Vbatt-H)

meaning.en: The battery circuit hardware overvoltage protection has tripped, so the RHI has locked out to protect the pack.
meaning.ur: Battery circuit ka hardware overvoltage protection trigger ho gaya, is liye RHI ne pack bachane ke liye lock out kar diya.

causes.en: Battery circuit 'jumps' - a loose or arcing battery connection under high charge current
causes.ur: Battery circuit mein 'jumps' - high charge current par battery connection loose ya arcing

causes.en: Battery pack internal cell imbalance or a failed BMS contactor
causes.ur: Battery pack mein internal cell imbalance ya BMS contactor fail

solutions.en: Check the circuit whether the battery circuit jumps: with the inverter off, inspect every battery connector and lug for heat marks, discolouration or looseness.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke battery circuit jump karta hai ya nahi: inverter off kar ke har battery connector aur lug par heat marks, rang badalna ya looseness dekhein.

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and the battery, then measure each pack's voltage at the inverter battery port; a pack well above its rating points to the pack, not the inverter.
solutions.ur: AC, PV aur battery isolate karke har pack ka voltage inverter battery port par measure karein; rating se zyada pack nikalay to masla pack ka hai, inverter ka nahi.

solutions.en: Restart the inverter. If it trips again with a healthy pack and clean connections, the pack BMS or contactor is faulty - RMA the battery.
solutions.ur: Inverter restart karein. Agar pack aur connections theek hone par bhi dobara trip kare to pack ka BMS ya contactor kharab hai - battery RMA karein.

source.title: Solis RHI(3-6)K-5G / RHI-(3.6)K-48ES-5G Series Hybrid Inverter User Manual ENX V1,5, Table 8.1 Fault message and description

meaning.en: The load connected to the backup port is above the inverter's rated backup output power, so the RHI shut that port down.
meaning.ur: Backup port se jula hua load inverter ki rated backup output power se zyada hai, is liye RHI ne wo port band kar diya.

causes.en: Backup load above the inverter's rated output power
causes.ur: Backup load inverter ki rated output power se zyada hai

causes.en: Large inrush from a motor or compressor on the backup circuit
causes.ur: Backup circuit par motor ya compressor ka bada inrush

solutions.en: Check the load of Backup port is over rating output power or not: add up the running watts of every backup appliance and compare with the RHI nameplate backup rating.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke backup port ka load rated output power se zyada hai ya nahi: har backup appliance ke running watts jama karke RHI nameplate ki backup rating se compare karein.

solutions.en: Reduce the load of Backup port, then restart inverter and confirm the code clears.
solutions.ur: Backup port ka load kam karein, phir inverter restart karke confirm karein ke code hat gaya.

solutions.en: If the alarm returns with a light load, measure the backup port voltage; an unstable backup voltage points to the inverter, not the load.
solutions.ur: Agar halki load par bhi alarm wapas aaye to backup port voltage measure karein; backup voltage unstable hai to masla inverter ka hai, load ka nahi.

source.title: Solis RHI(3-6)K-5G / RHI-(3.6)K-48ES-5G Series Hybrid Inverter User Manual ENX V1,5, Table 8.1 Fault message and description

meaning.en: The backup output voltage rose above the permitted window while running off-grid, so the RHI stopped.
meaning.ur: Off-grid chalte waqt backup output voltage permitted window se upar chala gaya, is liye RHI ruk gaya.

causes.en: Backup port wiring loose, so the measured backup voltage is false-high
causes.ur: Backup port wiring loose hai, is liye measured backup voltage ghalat high parha ja raha hai

causes.en: Generator connected to the same backup port, fighting the inverter output
causes.ur: Generator bhi isi backup port se connected hai aur inverter output se lad raha hai

causes.en: Direct sun on the cabinet and poor airflow while running hot
causes.ur: Cabinet par seedhi dhoop hai aur chalte waqt airflow kam hai

solutions.en: Switch off AC, PV and the battery, then check the backup port wiring: line, neutral and earth tight, and any generator correctly isolated through its changeover.
solutions.ur: AC, PV aur battery off karke backup port wiring check karein: line, neutral aur earth tight, aur generator sahi changeover ke zariye isolate hua ho.

solutions.en: Measure the backup port voltage with a multimeter while the RHI runs on battery and compare it with the configured backup voltage.
solutions.ur: RHI battery par chalte waqt multimeter se backup port voltage measure karein aur set ki hui backup voltage se compare karein.

solutions.en: Check inverter surrounding ventilation and whether sunshine is falling directly on the inverter in hot weather, then restart.
solutions.ur: Inverter ke aas-paas ventilation check karein aur dekhein ke garmi ke mausam mein dhoop seedhi lag rahi hai ya nahi, phir restart karein.

source.title: Solis RHI(3-6)K-5G / RHI-(3.6)K-48ES-5G Series Hybrid Inverter User Manual ENX V1,5, Table 8.1 Fault message and description
